insights.group_runtime_desc: From the first workflow start to the last workflow finish of the group, per pipeline.

repo.perm_sync_failed: Your permissions for this repository could not be synced with the forge. Your access is temporarily degraded to read-only.

enable.conflict_desc: This repository was recreated on the forge with a new ID, but an outdated entry with the same name still exists in Woodpecker. Delete the outdated to enable the new one or Repair the old.

allow_pr.desc: Allow the execution of pipelines on pull requests.

allow_deploy.desc: Allow deployments for successful pipelines. All users with push permissions can trigger these, so use with caution.

netrc_only_trusted.desc: Plugins that get access to netrc credentials that can be used to clone repositories from the forge or push them into the forge.

network.desc: Pipeline containers get access to network privileges like changing DNS.

volumes.desc: Pipeline containers are allowed to mount volumes.

security.desc: Pipeline containers get access to security privileges.

cancel_prev.desc: Selected event triggers cancel pending and running pipelines of the same event before starting the next one.
cancel_prev.keep_running_desc: Only cancel previous pipelines that have not started yet. A pipeline that is already running is left to finish.
cancel_prev.squash_desc: Only cancel previous pipelines that have not started yet, and run the new pipeline for their changed files too. A pipeline that is already running is left to finish.

workflow_groups.desc: Rules that sort workflows into groups and subgroups on the Insights tab, checked in order; the first rule whose pattern matches the workflow name wins. The pattern is a regular expression; group and subgroup may use {example} from it.
workflow_groups.builtin: Without rules the built-in ones apply: a name starting with build, module, service, svc or worker is Build; test, gate, check or nightly is Test; deploy, publish, release or staging is Deploy; anything else is Other. The subgroup is the subject in the name, e.g. svc-knowledge is Build / knowledge.

train.enabled_desc: Test the train branch in a promote pipeline whenever it is ahead of the target, fast-forward the target to the exact tested commit when it is green, and revert the change that broke it when it is red.
train.ignore_base_failures: Ignore failures already on the target
train.ignore_base_failures_desc: A workflow already red on the target's last promote or push pipeline does not stop a promote.
train.freeze_protection: Lock the train branch while frozen
train.freeze_protection_desc: Use branch protection to keep new merges off the train branch while the train is frozen or bisecting.
train.bot_token_set: A bot token is set; leave empty to keep it
train.bot_token_unset: Optional forge token the train writes with
train.desc: Approved pull requests merge into the train branch; the train promotes it to the target. Without a bot token the train writes with the repository owner's forge token.

crons.desc: Cron jobs can be used to trigger pipelines on a regular basis.
